title: Babe's last illness and heavy drinking
summary: His final week, the TB scare and test, a liver ailment, and his secret drinking.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: So, uh, I don't know. He, never did get down. He just was fine, kept going and going. And the last week when he got in that bed, I knew that was all. He'd set up here before he'd get in the bed. So, why don't you lay down? You feel bad? I'll tell him to that. No, I'm feeling all right. We won't go and be fixing this shit. And be so weak. I could see the weakness in him. I said, babe, go lay down. I don't want to lay down. If I had a little drink of wine. So, I'd send one of them, I'd say, go get him a half a pint of wine. And I'd put it on ice. He said, ooh, that was good. I'd get out of here and walk to that corner of that and stand up a while and come back, sit right in the chair. I'm down and sit up there in a chair and everybody be sleeping. I'd hear him snowing. I said, why don't you get up and go to bed? I'm going. I'm sitting up here thinking. He was only in the bed a week when he died. He got so thin. I said to the doctor that had some doctors used to come in to see me about my legs and they used to give me the exercise in the bed, you know, pull them and pull my arms and just turn me every kind of way by the inside out. And I said, I believe my husband got T.Vs. So, one of them looked down and good examined him first and he got no T.Vs. So, he said, I'll tell you what you do. He said, you make him go down in there and take a test. For sure enough, he did. The children carried him down there. And they sent his back and said, he was negative, no T.Vs. But he had the ferocious of the livers. The thicker had cooked his livers. You know, that's what was there. No T.Vs whatsoever. I was glad of that. That's what she said.
So, he had such an age. I don't want to get you drunk and everything.
Yeah, he drank hard. Oh, he'd slip out and drink. We couldn't stop him. He'd slip out and get it. So, he was just one of those things.
